description: Nonprime consumer loan lender with personal loans, auto finance, and credit cards.

catalyst.facts_line: 2026-10-30 (Friday, before the open), 41 days out -- from the earnings calendar, consensus EPS 1.88.
catalyst.why: The Q3 report must show credit losses and delinquencies rising enough to miss the $1.88 consensus, proving deterioration has reached reported numbers.

reasons: Subprime auto loan delinquencies hit 6.8% at the start of 2026, the worst in 32 years, and wholesale used-vehicle prices are softening year over year, so OneMain's auto-secured loans face higher defaults and lower collateral recovery.
Net income fell 32.7% quarter over quarter and operating profit fell 15.4%, yet consensus for Q3 is $1.88; nonprime borrowers face mounting debt pressures that will push credit losses higher.
OneMain's receivables grew 7% year over year as credit card and auto finance portfolios scaled, but that growth is into the weakest part of the consumer credit cycle, so losses will follow.

quants.eps_revisions: tilted lower, with 6 up and 8 down over last 30 days
extra: Last quarter net income decreasing 33% quarter over quarter (6/30/2026)
Last quarter other operating items increasing 31% quarter over quarter (6/30/2026)

structuring.thesis_target: Targets the 2026-10-30 report, with the long leg expiring 2026-11-20, which gives the deterioration time to show up.
structuring.reflection: The conservative credit ratio is 7.9%, below the 10% floor; selling two more short puts clears it but adds early assignment risk if OMF drops hard before October 16. Net debit is $3,888.
